scope: Additive nonvirtual source-frame correlation helper for selected empty AC1024 SORTENTSTABLE custom objects with exactly one parent-dictionary reactor, no EED or extension dictionary, and a frame at most 4 MiB.
authority: ODA Open Design Specification v5.4.1 section 20.4.93 describes the entry count, inline sort handles, parent/reactor/extension links, block owner and entity handles. The existing parser was not changed. Custom type 510 is observed in the source, not assumed as a general class number.
implementation: DRW_SortEntsTable::matchesAc1024EmptyDwgFrame verifies the bounded raw/typed common fields, class identity and source publication/membership, then reparses the source frame and compares the exact empty body and block owner. It requires matching parent reactor and rejects exceptions and unmodeled dependencies. LIBDXFRW_HAS_AC1024_EMPTY_SORTENTS_SOURCE_VERIFY advertises the method.
validation: Four physical source tables F3, 2121, 21D3 and 22D4 matched their raw, typed, publication and membership records. F3 is the model-space table and remains included as a control; the helper does not imply omission.

Controls reject changed typed owner, reactor and entry count; altered raw object type, truncation, reactor metadata, version and class; wrong publication ordinal/carrier; changed membership owner/count/class ordinal; and a flipped bit inside each empirically traced wire owner field. The field positions come from the existing parser diagnostic, not an independent decoder.

Across the four physical records, 164 calibrated allocation failures refused and each immediately retried successfully. The focused SORTENTSTABLE and DICTIONARY tests, AC1024 layer binding and plot-style graph tests passed. The LC3 compatibility target built under the existing strict compiler settings.

Source-release inventory and 18 generator refusal controls pass with 1212 files. Hosted-profile CTest inventory increases from 1373 to 1374, adding exactly this test. Native contract/self-test and the 721-input implementation digest pass.
limits: Correlation uses caller-provided receipts and the existing parser; it does not authenticate source origin or CLASSES, validate enclosing CRC, independently prove unknown fields, establish a frozen import generation or exclude inbound references. It does not authorize omission, export, native semantics or support claims.
